containers.name: probe
command:
import json
import time
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import urlopen
base = "http://prometheus-k8s.monitoring.svc:9090/api/v1/"
q = 'absent(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="kubesizer-postgres-pilot-pgp1",container="database"})'
try:
    with urlopen(base+"query?"+urlencode({"query":q}), timeout=10) as r:
        d=json.load(r)
    print(json.dumps({"status":d["status"], "result_type":d["data"]["resultType"]}),flush=True)
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({"error":f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}),flush=True)
time.sleep(150)
